title: KDM3B enforces a non-mutational ErbB signaling state that sustains cholangiocarcinoma.
publicationName: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
journalName: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
snippet: More than 50% of cholangiocarcinoma (CCA) patients lack druggable mutations, showing broad non-mutational epigenetic perturbations, whose mechanistic insights and clinical benefit remain largely unexplored.
